## Update Relevant Documents
<sub><i> **Required when:** this PR changes behavior, APIs, schemas, environment variables, or setup steps that other developers rely on.</i></sub>

Documentation drift is one of the most common causes of onboarding friction for new contributors. If your changes affect how the project is set up, used, or understood, please update the relevant docs in the same PR.

- [ ] `../README.md` — user-facing changes, new setup steps, new scripts
- [ ] `../docs` — schema changes, architecture updates, integration guides. List docs changing.
- [ ] Inline code comments — non-obvious logic, workarounds, or decisions worth preserving
- [ ] No documentation changes needed
